title: CEDAR · The tree through the house
venue: the novel of the timber country · never past the corner box · Box 14
logline: A cedar growing through a house on the logging road: through the porch, through the kitchen table, through the roof, the family eating around it. Nobody in the house finds it strange. The page draws the table set for four with the trunk at the head.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a house on a logging road with a cedar's trunk going in through the porch and out through the roof, the crown above the chimney.

image.prompt: a small wooden house on a gravel logging road with a cedar's trunk entering through the porch and leaving through the roof, its crown above the chimney, wet-on-wet watercolor

panels.name: Road

panels.composition: Tier 2: the kitchen: a table set for four with the trunk at its head, a family eating, unbothered.

image.prompt: a kitchen with a table set for four and a cedar trunk standing at the head of the table, a family eating around it unbothered, wet-on-wet watercolor

panels.name: Stop

panels.composition: Tier 3: the trunk close where it passes through the tabletop, the wood of the table and the wood of the tree grown into each other.

image.prompt: close on a cedar trunk passing through a wooden tabletop with the table's grain and the tree's bark grown into each other, wet-on-wet watercolor
